projects.title: Codie — Programming Laboratory
projects.problem: Learning and practicing code across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL usually means juggling multiple tools, local servers, and database clients — with no shared workspace to run and compare experiments safely.
projects.solution: Built Codie, a browser-based programming laboratory with dedicated labs for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL: a CodeMirror-powered editor with bracket matching, code folding, auto-close tags, and code beautification; server-side PHP and SQL execution sandboxes; saveable experiments with session-based user accounts; and a modular front-end architecture (core state/UI/API modules + SQL lab engine).
projects.role: Designer & full-stack developer — application architecture, editor integration, sandboxed execution APIs, and the full UI design system
features: Six dedicated labs: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and Full Stack
CodeMirror editor with syntax highlighting, bracket matching, code folding, auto-close tags, and placeholders
One-click code beautification (HTML/CSS/JS) and live run/execute for client and server-side code
Sandboxed PHP and SQL execution through a REST-style API
Save experiments per user with session-based login and registration
Automated test suite (50+ tests), visual inspection pages, and full documentation
security: Session-based authentication with login and registration
Server-side validation of all executed code
Execution sandboxing for PHP and SQL labs

projects.title: Itara — IT Asset Management System
projects.problem: Organizations need a single source of truth for every IT asset — PCs, laptops, switches, servers, printers — plus who they are assigned to, where they are, warranty status, and how the network connects. Spreadsheets cannot provide accountability or an audit trail.
projects.solution: Designed and built a complete production-ready ITAM platform from scratch: a custom PHP 8 MVC framework (zero framework dependencies), MySQL/MariaDB backend, interactive HTML5 Canvas network topology with drag-and-drop/zoom/connect modes, analytics dashboard with charts, CSV import/export, QR support, full audit trail, role-based access control, and a RESTful API.
projects.role: Architect & full-stack developer — designed the MVC core, database schema, security layer, topology engine, and all modules
features: Asset ledger with auto-generated tags (PC-001, SRV-001…) and rich hardware fields
Interactive network topology: drag-and-drop, zoom/pan, connect/disconnect links, labels, PNG export, position persistence
Analytics dashboard — type/status/department charts and monthly trend trends
Full audit logging of every CRUD operation
CSV import/export, backup system, mail queue worker, warranty expiry tracking
Unit & integration test suite, database migrations
security: CSRF protection on all forms (dedicated middleware)
SQL injection prevention with PDO prepared statements
Session security — HttpOnly + SameSite cookies, periodic regeneration
Security headers + secure file upload validation

projects.title: Media Uploader
projects.problem: Departments needed a secure way to upload and organize media files without dumping everything into shared folders with no access control.
projects.solution: Built a web application with department-based storage, validated uploads, role-based access, and an audit-friendly event log.

projects.title: Barcode Warehouse System
projects.problem: Tracking items across Production → Warehouse → Delivery was error-prone when done by hand.
projects.solution: Implemented barcode-driven scanning at each stage, giving real-time item location and movement history.

projects.solution: Replaced the shared-file workflow with a proper multi-user web application backed by a relational database.
